context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 19 tested NEW Tenable VM features. Key endpoints: (1) POST /api/tenable/auto-assess - Auto-updates NIST 800-53 control compliance from Tenable findings. Returns message, controls_updated count, assessments list with control_id/status/reason/evidence_count. Updated 26 controls. (2) POST /api/tenable/generate-poam - Creates POA&M entries from non-compliant findings with severity-based timelines (critical=15d/P1, high=30d/P2, medium=90d/P3). Returns message, total, entries list. (3) GET /api/tenable/poam - Lists all POA&M entries with id, poam_id, title, weakness, description, severity, priority, control_ids, asset, source, remediation_plan, scheduled_completion, status, cves. (4) PUT /api/tenable/poam/{entry_id}/status - Updates POA&M status (open, in_progress, completed, delayed). (5) POST /api/tenable/generate-policies - AI-generates remediation policies using GPT-5.2 (takes 2-3 minutes, may timeout). Frontend: Action bar on dashboard tab with 3 buttons (data-testid='auto-assess-btn', 'generate-policies-btn', 'generate-poam-btn'). Assessment result banner (data-testid='assess-result'). POA&M tab (data-testid='tab-poam') with stats, entries (data-testid='poam-{id}'), status action buttons (data-testid='poam-progress-{id}', 'poam-complete-{id}').
